manifest.description: Pull repeated setup/setup_all blocks across *_test.exs files into a fixture module exposed via `use FixtureModule, :name` via elixir_test_fixture_extract.
when_to_use: a setup block is duplicated across 3+ test files verbatim (default min_duplicates)
test boilerplate has accumulated and a fixture module would clean it up
anti_patterns: do not use when setups depend on test-module @attributes without acknowledge_attribute_scope=true
do not use to merge setups that look similar but aren't byte-equal — hash equality is exact

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-test-fixture-extract.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_test_fixture_extract", source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={"fixture_name": "{{fixture_name}}", "min_duplicates": {{min_duplicates}}, "acknowledge_attribute_scope": {{acknowledge_attribute_scope}}, "acknowledge_describe_context": {{acknowledge_describe_context}}}).
2. Refuse on no_duplicates / setup_references_module_scope / describe_context_required.
3. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<duplicate_groups count + occurrences>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{fixture_name}} {{min_duplicates}} {{acknowledge_attribute_scope}} {{acknowledge_describe_context}}
